newsletter-subscribe-loginrequired: Fadlan soo gal si aad uga qaybqaadato [[Special:Newsletters|wargeysyada]].

newsletter-unsubscribe-text: Boggan wuxuu kuu oggolaanayaa inaad ka baxdo diiwaangelinta wargeyska "$1". Haddii aad ka baxdo diiwaangelinta, ma heli doontid ogeysiisyo marka la shaaciyo arrimo cusub oo wargeyskan ah.
newsletter-unsubscribe-success: Mar dambe ma tihid qof ka diiwaangashan "$1".
newsletter-unsubscribe-fail: Lama laga bixi karo diiwaangelinta wargeyska "$1" sababtoo ah hadda kama diiwaangashnid wargeyskan.
newsletter-unsubscribe-error: Khalad ayaa ka dhacay ka bixitaanka diiwaangelinta wargeyska.

newsletter-edit-subscribers-nochanges: Wax isbeddel ah laguma samayn liiska isdiiwaangeliyayaasha wargeyska.
